spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (मणति)
To sound, to sound inarticulately.

mf. (-णिः-णिः or -णी)
1 A gem, a jewel, a precious stone.
2 A pearl.
3 Fleshy processes pending from the neck of a goat.
4 A small water pot.
5 The glans penis.
6 The clitoris.
7 The wrist.
8 One of the Nāgas or serpent chiefs of Pātāla.
E.
मण to sound, aff. इन्.

n. (-कं)
A small water jar, a pitcher.
E.
मणि the same, aff. कन्.

f. (-का)
A weight of eight Palas.

m. (-ण्ठः)
The blue jay.
E.
मणि a jewel, and कण्ठ the throat.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णी-र्णं)
Jewel-eared.
E.
मणि, and कर्ण the ear.

f. (-का)
A holy pool at Benares, in which pilgrims are directed to bathe, and adjacent ghāt.
E.
मणि, and कर्ण the ear, aff. कन्, fem. form. Devi having dropped one of her earrings at this place.

m. (-चः)
The feathered part of an arrow.

n. (-नं)
The neck or throat.
E.
मणि a jewel, and कानन a wood; abounding with such ornaments.

m. (-रः)
A jeweller, a lapidary or worker in precious stones.
E.
मणि a gem, and कार who makes.

m. (-वः)
One of KUVERA'S sons.
E.
मणि a gem, and ग्रीवा the neck.

Marrow.
2
A sort of drug.

n. (-तं)
Low murmuring sound.
E.
मण to sound, aff. क्त.

m. (-कः)
The Indian crane.
E.
मणि a jewel, तॄ to pass over, aff. ण्वुल्.

m. (-पः)
The crest or hood of the great serpent ANANTA.
E.
मणि a jewel, and द्वीप a continent.

m. (-नुः)
The rainbow.
E.
मणि a jewel, and धनुष् a bow.

m. (-रः)
1 The navel.
2 A sort of bodice worn by women, and often richly ornamented with jewels.
n. (-रं)
The pit of the stomach, as one of the mystical cakras of the body: see चक्र.
E.
मणि a jewel, and पूर filling, full.

m. (-न्धः)
The wrist.
E.
मणि a jewel, and बन्ध binding; where bracelets of precious stones are bound.

n. (-न्धं)
Sea salt.
E.
मणिबन्ध a mountain, अण् aff.; found there.

m. (-द्रः)
1 One of the Jinas, or Jaina deified teachers.
2 A name of the king of the Yakṣas.

f. (-त्तिः)
The palace of the great serpent, ŚEṢA Nāga.
E.
मणि a jewel, and भित्ति a wall.

f. (-मिः)
A jewel mine, or a place where gems or precious stones are found.
E.
मणि a gem, and भूमि ground; also मणिभू f. (-भूः).

m. (-पः)
1 The capital of Śeṣa.
2 The palace of NAIRṚTA, regent of the S. W. quarter.
E.
मणि a jewel, and मण्डप a building.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Having jewels, possessed of or adorned with them.
m. (-मान्)
The sun.
E.
मणि, and मतुप् poss. aff.

n. (-ध्यं)
A species of the Vṛhatī metre.

n. (-न्थं)
1 A mountain or range where salt is found
2 Rock salt.
E.
मणि a gem, and मन्थ what churns; also माणिमन्थ.

n. (-न्थं)
Sea salt.
E.
मणिमन्थ a mountain, from which the salt is supposed to be produced, and अण् aff.

f. (-ला)
1 A necklace, a zone, a fillet, &c. of precious stones.
2 An impression left by a bite.
3 The goddess LAKṢMĪ.
4 Light, lustre.
5 A species of the Jagatī metre.
E.
मणि a gem, and माला a necklace, &c.

n. (-त्नं)
A precious gem.
E.
मणि, and रत्न a jewel, or the best of any thing.

m. (-वः)
One of the Nāgas or serpents of Pātāla.
E.
मणि a gem, and व poss. aff.

m. (-जः)
The pomegranate.
E.
मणि a gem, and वीज seed.

n. (-रं)
A string of gems, a necklace, &c.
E.
मणि, and सर what goes.

m. (-नः)
A staff or stick set with jewels.
E.
मणि a jewel, सौपान a ladder.

n. (-कं)
The moon gem, probably a sort of crystal.
m. (-कः)
A kingfisher.

n. (-कं)
A flower.
E.
मण to sound, deriv. irr.

mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं)
1 Scum, skimmings, froth, foam, barm, &c., the upper part of any infusion in a state of boiling or ferment.
2 Pith, essence.
3 The head.
m. (-ण्डः)
1 Ornament, decoration.
2 The castor oil tree, (Palma christi.)
3 A sort of potherb.
f. (-ण्डा)
1 Spirituous or vinous liquor.
2 Emblic myrobalan.
E.
मडि to adorn, Uṇādi aff. ड.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Adorning, dressing, decorating, fond of or putting on ornaments.
n. (-नं)
Ornament, decoration, jewels, trinkets, &c.
E.
मडि to adorn, aff. युच्.

mn. (-पः-पं)
1 A temporary building, an open shed or hall, adorned with flowers and erected on festival occasions, as at marriages, &c.
2 An open temple or building consecrated to a deity.
E.
मण्ड ornament, and पा to preserve, aff. क.

m. (-न्तः)
An ornament, a decoration of trinkets, jewels, &c.
f. (-न्ती)
A woman, a wife.
E.
मडि to adorn, Uṇādi aff. झच्. fem. aff. ङीप्.

f. (-री)
The mole cricket.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
The disk of the sun or moon.
n. (-लं)
1 The sun's disk.
2 An orb, a circumference in general or the circle bounding the view, the sensible horizon.
3 (In astronomy,) A great circle, as नाडीमण्डलं the equator, क्रान्तिमण्डलं the ecliptic.
4 A ball, a globe.
5 A wheel.
6 A province, a region, a district, extending twenty, or according to some authorities, forty Yojanas every way.
7 The country or empire, over which the twelve princes termed Cakravartīs are supposed to have ruled; perhaps the peninsula of India, where the term Maṇḍala or Mandel is of constant occurrence, to signify a province or district, as in Coromandet, &c.
8 Surrounding or contiguous countries.
9 A sort of leprosy with circular spots.
10 A heap, a quantity, a multitude or [] assemblage.
11 An attitude in shooting, the fifth position, in which both knees are bent.
12 The impression or scratch of a finger nail.
13 A sort of perfume, resembling in appearance a dried shell fish.
14 A sort of mystical diagram.
15 A sweetmeat, a sugar-ball.
16 A form of array, an army drawn up in a circle.
m. (-लः)
1 A kind of snake.
2 A dog.
f. (-ली)
Bent grass.
E.
मडि to adorn, aff. कलच्.

n. (-कं)
1 An orb or disk.
2 A sort of leprosy, with large round spots.
3 A mirror.
4 A form of array, an army drawn up in a circle.
5 A circular figure or diagram.
m. (-कः)
A dog.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

n. (-त्यं)
Dancing in a ring, especially a dance imitative of one, said to have been danced by the Gopīs round KṚṢṆA and his mistress RĀDHĀ.
E.
मण्डल a circle, and नृत्य dancing^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-ग्रः)
A sword, a scimitar.
E.
मण्डल a circle, and अग्र top or point.

n. (-तं)
A ball, a globe.
E.
मण्डल a circle, क्यप् aff., and क्त added.

m. (-शः)
An emperor, a king of kings.
E.
मण्डल an extensive district or empire, and अधीश sovereign.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
1 Being in a circle, made up into a coil or ball.
2 Surrounded by.
m. (-ली)
1 A large species of snake.
2 A cat.
3 A polecat.
4 A dog.
5 The sun.
6 The ruler or governor of a Maṇḍala or district.
E.
मण्डल a circle, and इनि aff.

n. (-णं)
Rounding, gathering in a ball or a circle, coiling, &c.
E.
मण्डल, and करण making, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Rounded, made round or globular, gathered in a ball or circle.
E.
मण्डल, and कृत made, च्चि augment.

m. (-शः)
An emperor, a supreme monarch.
E.
मण्डल an empire, and ईश sovereign.

m. (-रः)
A sovereign, a monarch.
E.
मण्डल a district, and ईश्वर a sovereign; the power of this prince is limited by AMARA, and the Maṇḍaleśvara is considered as an emperor or supreme prince, only when in addition to his territorial sway, he has performed the Rājasūya sacrifice, or sacrifice in which he has been attended by all his tributary or subject princes: other authorities confound the sovereign of a Maṇḍala, with the Cakravartī or emperor, and with the Samrāj or lord paramount, and others confine him to the government of a district of twenty or forty Yojanas in each direction.

m. (-कः)
A distiller.
E.
मण्ड froth, ferment, and हृ to take, aff. अण्, and कन् added.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Ornamented, adorned.
m. (-तः)
One of the eleven persons called Gaṇādhipas by the Jainas.
E.
मडि to adorn, aff. क्त.

m. (-कः)
1 A frog.
2 The name of a

Muni.
3

A flower, (Bignonia Indica.)
f. (-का-की)
Madder, (Rubia Manjith.)
f. (-की)
1 A female or small frog.
2 A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica, or Hydrocotyle Asiatica.)
3 An unchaste or abandoned woman.
E.
मडि to ornament, Uṇādi aff. ऊकन्.

mf. (-र्णः-र्णी)
A plant, (Bignonia Indica.)
f. (-र्णी)
1 Bengal madder, (Rubia Manjith.)
2 A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.)
3 A sort of creeper, (Hydrocotyle Asiatica.)
E.
मण्डूक a frog, and पर्ण a leaf, compared to the animal in shape or colour.

mn. (-रः-रं)
Rust of iron.
E.
मडि to adorn, ऊरच् aff.

n. (-कं)
1 Painting figures or flowers, on the walls or floors of an apartment, &c. on festival occasions, with a white pigment made from ground rice.
2 Variegated colour.
E.
मण्ड scum, and उदक water.

m. (-कः)
A small shrub, (Arum Indicum.)

m. (-वः)
1 A child.
2 A man, (in a contemptuous sense,) a manikin.
3 A necklace of sixteen strings.
E.
मनु a man, and अण् aff.; also मानव.

m. (-कः)
1 A child, a boy not exceeding sixteen years of age, a manikin.
2 A pupil, a scholar, a religious student.
3 A man, an ignorant or ridiculous man, a childish man.
4 A necklace of twenty strings.
5 A species of the Anuṣṭubh metre.
E.
कन् added to the last.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Boyish, childish, fit or suitable for a child.
E.
माणव as above, and खञ् aff.

n. (-व्यं)
1 A number of boys.
2 Boyhood.
E.
माणव a boy, यत् aff. of property or multitude.

n. (-क्यं)
A ruby.
f. (-क्या)
A house lizard.
E.
मणि a gem, कै to call, यत् or यञ् added.
